svg.text: One complete SSI4 Read Cycle at 2 MHz — DATA shifted by the clock itself
32 clocks · T = 500 ns · decoded PV=1 ZPD=1 PD=370085 TS=1200 · Tmu = 19.66 us
clock rising edges — one per bit; each bit is written 56 ns after its rising edge and stays valid across the falling edge, where the controller samples
